deadline.value: No formal deadline; the School encourages applications in early January, and scholarship deadlines can be earlier.
deadline.quote: The School does not have a formal deadline for PhD applications, but all candidates are encouraged to submit their applications in early January in the year they want to begin their studies.

gre_subject.value: No Mathematics GRE requirement appears on the School's pages.

supervisor.value: Check that a research group matches your interests before applying; a supervisory team is assigned.
supervisor.quote: Before you apply, please ensure that at least one of these research groups matches your interests.

funding.value: The offer of a PhD place does not guarantee financial support; funding is applied for separately.
funding.quote: the offer of a PhD place does not guarantee financial support

entry_route.value: Requires an upper second-class honours degree; the first degree must be in Mathematics, Statistics or a very closely related subject.
entry_route.quote: The minimum requirement set by the University for admission as a postgraduate research student is an upper second class Honours degree from a UK University (or an equivalent international degree).

also.quote: The School requires that the first degree of an applicant is in Mathematics, Statistics or a very closely related subject.

notes: Covers the School's PhD areas in applied mathematics, pure mathematics and statistics.
